translation.title: Ketoprofen Cataplasm (Pap)
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for pain relief and anti-inflammation in degenerative arthritis (osteoarthritis), periarthritis of the shoulder, tendinitis and tenosynovitis, peritendinitis, epicondylitis of the humerus (tennis elbow, etc.), muscle pain, and post-traumatic swelling and pain.
translation.usage: Remove the release liner from the adhesive side and apply the cataplasm to the affected area twice a day.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, if you have or have had aspirin-induced asthma (asthma attacks caused by non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics, etc.), if you are hypersensitive to ingredients that can cause cross-hypersensitivity (tiaprofenic acid, fenofibrate, bezafibrate, ciprofibrate, oxybenzone), if you are 6 months or more pregnant, or for children under 15 years. Do not use it on the eyes or mucous membranes, on damaged skin or mucous membranes, on areas with eczema or rash, or on athlete's foot or ringworm (tinea). Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you have bronchial asthma, or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Photosensitivity may occur - avoid ultraviolet light while using this medicine and for up to 2 weeks after use. Do not use it under an occlusive dressing. If your symptoms do not improve after about 1 week of use, stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Adverse reactions may occur - rarely shock and anaphylactoid symptoms (hives, difficulty breathing, facial swelling and other hypersensitivity-like symptoms) and early symptoms such as dry crackles, wheezing and difficulty breathing; sometimes contact dermatitis with redness, rash, itching, blisters, oozing, irritation and swelling, dry skin and pigmentation, photosensitivity caused by direct sunlight (ultraviolet light), and skin rash spreading over the whole body; if any of these occur, stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Store at room temperature away from moisture and light, and keep out of reach of children.
